messages:
elaine: quick report from support - new user ran the quickstart across three SDKs (py, js, go). py & go surfaced a clear billing error, js printed 'request succeeded' and app showed no text. they attached stdout for each.

mike: can you paste the js output? this sounds like the streaming handler not treating a gating body as terminal error.

elaine: js stdout:
```
$ node examples/hello.js --key sk-xxx
Calling model=open-7b
Request succeeded
Done
```
python stdout:
```
$ python hello.py --key sk-xxx
Starting request
Error: Billing required: accept billing contact to generate
```
go stdout:
```
$ ./hello_cli --key sk-xxx
request sent
ERROR: service account blocked until billing accepted
```
so only js shows the misleading success.

sam: did they include raw responses?

elaine: yes - server returned a single json body then connection close for js case:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json

{"id":"r_42","status":"partial","detail":"billing_ack_required","message":"Accept billing to generate","streaming":false}
```
python/go got 402/403 with structured error body.

kevin: interesting - infra is returning different gates depending on org state (preview vs blocked). JS streaming path expects chunked event stream; a single JSON + close gets parsed but the library treats that as a non-error result. we should not show 'Request succeeded' for bodies where `detail` indicates billing gating.

mike: action items: (1) JS sdk patch to detect gating sentinels (detail in ["billing_ack_required","billing_preview_only"]) and throw a BillingRequiredError instead of success. (2) Add cross-sdk parity test that asserts all official SDKs raise on gating. (3) Docs: onboarding note + CS canned msg about preview footprints not being billed.

billing-bot: Clarification: preview or gating attempts are tracked as "preview footprint" and are not charged. Dashboard quick views can make them look like usage; we'll add an explanatory tooltip.

elaine: temporary workaround I sent to the user: accept billing invite or create a new workspace with billing enabled. Also recommended updating to latest JS SDK when published.

kevin: I'll open a small patch for js-sdk@1.4.5: streaming will parse the final json and if streaming==false && detail in gating set -> throw. Also change retry middleware to not retry on 4xx or gating bodies.

sam: I'll add a test harness in infra that can toggle between returning 402, 403, or 200-with-detail so SDK CI can catch regressions. Ticket INF-4755.

mike: once JS patch lands, add a blurbs/FAQ entry under onboarding: "Why did my quickstart show success but no text?" with steps and screenshots.

devexp-bot: js-sdk@1.4.5 published (patch) - surfaces billing gating as BillingRequiredError; added parity tests.

elaine: user accepted billing and retried; streaming text returned. closing after docs PR made. thanks team :heart:
